summary: Maintain a requested groom replacement only while the experiment and its bound lab scene are active.

faults.when: Validation refused a document; keep normal hair and offer correction.
No usable scalp is available; keep normal hair and offer Try again.
Generation or rendering failed; restore normal hair and offer Try again.

lifetime: Per request identity, aborted when its request ends, experiment turns off, panel withdraws demand, groom changes or character geometry changes.
x-publication: Attach a complete matching coarse result before superseding resolved hair; atomically swap to refined output. Late results cannot change visibility. Withdrawing demand restores normal hair immediately.
